Age-Related Effects of AT1 Receptor Antagonist Losartan on Cognitive Decline in Spontaneously Hypertensive Rats. Both hypertension and aging are known to increase the vulnerability of the brain to neurovascular damage, resulting in cognitive impairment. The present study investigated the efficacy of the antihypertensive drug losartan on age- and hypertension-associated cognitive decline and the possible mechanism underlying its effect in spontaneously hypertensive rats (SHRs).
